name: CDB
recent: CelcomDigi 近期与 Huawei Malaysia 签署三年合作备忘录，培训员工面向 AI 时代的技术能力，并开设第三家旗舰店。公司同时披露第二 interim 免税单层股息每股 3.4 仙，除息日为 2026 年 9 月 10 日。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比微增 0.3%，但净利同比下滑 9.3%。
notable: 与 Huawei Malaysia 签署三年合作备忘录，培训员工面向 AI 时代的技术能力。
开设第三家旗舰店，位于 118 Mall。
宣布 2026 财年第二次中期免税单层股息每股 3.4 仙。
risks: 首席策略、转型与监管官 Datuk Kamal Bin Khalid 于 2026 年 8 月 18 日出售 15,000 股普通股。
最新季度净利同比下滑 9.3%，净利率由 13.0% 降至 12.5%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 31.86 亿，同比增 0.3%，环比减 0.7%；净利为 MYR 3.98 亿，同比减 9.3%，环比减 4.8%；净利率 12.5%，低于上一季度的 13.0%。

recent_en: CelcomDigi recently signed a three-year MoU with Huawei Malaysia to train its workforce for the AI era and opened its third flagship store. The company also declared a second interim tax-exempt single-tier dividend of 3.4 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 September 2026. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 0.3% year-on-year while net profit fell 9.3% year-on-year.
notable_en: Signed a three-year MoU with Huawei Malaysia to train its workforce for the AI era.
Opened its third flagship store at 118 Mall.
Declared a second interim tax-exempt single-tier dividend of 3.4 sen per share for FY2026.
risks_en: Chief Strategy, Transformation and Regulatory Officer Datuk Kamal Bin Khalid disposed of 15,000 ordinary shares on 18 August 2026.
Latest quarter net profit fell 9.3% year-on-year, with net margin declining from 13.0% to 12.5%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 3.186 billion, up 0.3% year-on-year and down 0.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 398 million, down 9.3% year-on-year and 4.8% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 12.5%, lower than 13.0% in the previous quarter.
